summary.text: Duy Nguyen is a Democratic member of the Nevada State Assembly who has represented District 8 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He has worked in nonprofit leadership and served as a Clark County planning commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Duy Nguyen was born in Vietnam and lives in Nevada; he earned a B.S. in business management in 2006 and an M.B.A. in 2008, both from the University of Phoenix.

His career experience includes working as executive director of the nonprofit One APIA Nevada, vice president and COO of the Asian Community Development Council, and planning commissioner for Clark County, as well as account executive for Cox Business and senior community relations specialist for Cox Communications.
He assumed office on November 9, 2022, succeeding Jason Frierson.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Government Affairs (as vice chair), Growth and Infrastructure, Health and Human Services (as vice chair), and Revenue committees.
His Republican opponent in the 2026 general election is Joseph Charafi.
